t: What is SMA (Spinal Muscular Atrophy)? | SMN1 & SMN2 Genes
s: Spinal muscular atrophy is caused by a mutation in the survival motor neuron 1 (SMN1) gene. This gene is responsible for producing survival motor neuron (SMN) protein, which maintains the health and normal function of motor neurons. In individuals with spinal muscular atrophy, both copies of the SMN1 gene are mutated, leading to decreased production of SMN protein.
